授業概要
建築分野で消費されるエネルギー消費量は日本のエネルギー消費量全体の約１／３を占める。持続型社会の形成のために、建築分野が果たすべき役割は大きい。持続型社会における建築はどうあるべきか、エネルギー供給をどのように行っていくべきかなどの議論を通して、持続型社会の実現に向けて建築関連技術者が取り組むべき課題について考える。また、環境建築を構想する上で必要となる基礎的な事項について学ぶ。
The amount of energy consumed in the architectural field accounts for around one-third of the total energy consumed in Japan. The architectural field has a significant role to play in the development of sustainable societies. Through discussions on questions such as how architecture needs to be in sustainable societies and how the supply of energy should be conducted, we will consider the issues that need to be addressed by technical experts in the field of architecture in the pursuit of achieving sustainable societies. We will also learn about the fundamental points that need to be considered when designing environmental architecture.
We will discuss ideal model architecture in a sustainable society and learn about the basic aspects needed in the planning of environmental architecture.

全体の教育目標
エネルギー問題を中心に社会を取り巻く様々な課題を、統計データ等に基づいて認識し、その課題解決のために様々な視点から検証し、解決策を構築する能力を養う。
To foster the ability to draw on statistical data and other such material to recognize the various energy-related issues and other such challenges facing society, adopt various perspectives to investigate potential means of addressing those challenges, and develop measures that provide solutions.
個別の教育目標
社会におけるエネルギーの重要性を理解する。また、データに基づく検証ができるようになる。エネルギー問題を通して建築のあるべき姿を理解し、そのデザインや広域の都市計画などに活かすための知識を身につける。
To acquire an understanding of the importance of energy in society, and to develop the ability to verify issues and approaches on the basis of data. To understand how architecture needs to develop by considering it from the perspective of energy issues, and to acquire knowledge that can be drawn on for designing such architecture, providing wide-ranging urban planning, and other such tasks.
